text:
Marta: Heads-up — on the prod fleet I'm seeing KV memory drift for long-context sessions (>64k tokens). Hit rate falls from ~0.95 -> ~0.6 over the session and eviction counters spike. Posting profiler dump shortly.
Kevin: Can you paste the raw metrics or a dashboard link?
Marta: Dashboard snapshot: https://redwood.internal/d/kv/evictions?orgId=1&panelId=3
Marta: Metrics snippet:
```
kv.cache_residency: 0.62
kv.cache_hit_rate: 0.68
kv.eviction_total: 1248
kv.eviction_pager_scan: 142
kv.pager_reads: 398
kv.fragmentation_ratio: 0.23
kv.avg_kv_entry_bytes: 1536
```
perf-bot: Profile job 2026-11-02T14:23 completed — flamegraph: https://perf.redwood/job/fg/abcd. Summary: heavy time in pager scan path (~12ms/scan) and kernel-select stalls when large KV lookups overlap with attention kernels.
Laura: If fragmentation_ratio > 0.2 that's actionable. Proposal: add eviction_reason counters (memory_pressure | ttl | size_limit), avg_kv_size, long_context_residency metric.
Jon: Also suspect batching heuristics: some requests keep long prefixes in queue causing reuse to drop. Can we add a per-request prefix_len histogram (p50/p95)?
Kevin: I'll add panels and an alert. Suggested alert: eviction_rate > 50/min sustained for 5m => paging incident.
Marta: Quick experiment: bumped pager_threshold 0.8 -> 0.9. Evictions dropped ~30% but tail latency p95 increased by ~8ms. Tradeoff unclear.
Laura: :thinking_face: We should canary LRU compaction + pager rate-limiter together. I'll open a canary ticket and include suggested metrics.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout created: canary/kv-reclaim-v2 across 10 hosts — https://deploy.redwood/canary/kv-reclaim-v2
Kevin: I'll coordinate dashboard panels + alert rules and attach to the canary. tagging @Jon for batching heuristic changes.
Jon: On it. Will push a diff for batching heuristics (reduce long-prefix batching windows) for review by EOD.
Marta: Thanks — I'll upload profiler dumps and a few long-context traces to the canary ticket so the canary can be validated against real traces. :thumbsup:
